description: Excalibur gate methods. Exported from internal/api Methods; do not edit by hand without updating the registry.

methods.name: conversation.send
methods.summary: Send a message; idempotent on client_msg_id.

methods.name: conversation.subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribe to typed events from a cursor.

methods.name: conversation.history
methods.summary: Read message history with pagination.

methods.name: run.list
methods.summary: List runs with state and queue position.

methods.name: run.status
methods.summary: Deterministic snapshot of a run (Section 15.6).

methods.name: run.pause
methods.summary: Pause a run and its subtree with immediate interrupt.

methods.name: run.resume
methods.summary: Resume what a matching pause paused.

methods.name: run.interrupt
methods.summary: Stop the current model call and tool per cancel class.

methods.name: run.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a run and its descendants bottom-up.

methods.name: run.redirect
methods.summary: Send a directive, resuming the target if paused.

methods.name: task.start
methods.summary: Create a delegated task and return immediately.

methods.name: task.status
methods.summary: Status, current step, plan progress, live tool line.

methods.name: task.wait
methods.summary: Wait for completion or for a pending answer.

methods.name: task.result
methods.summary: Delivery report: summary, files, branch/diff, criteria, pending.

methods.name: task.reply
methods.summary: Answer a pending question or add a directive.

methods.name: task.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a delegated task.

methods.name: task.pause
methods.summary: Pause a delegated task.

methods.name: task.resume
methods.summary: Resume a delegated task.

methods.name: task.list
methods.summary: List tasks, optionally filtered by project.

methods.name: task.logs
methods.summary: Live event stream of a task as JSONL.

methods.name: project.list
methods.summary: List registered projects.

methods.name: project.register
methods.summary: Register a project with roots and settings.

methods.name: project.get
methods.summary: Describe one project.

methods.name: plan.approve
methods.summary: Approve a pending macro plan.

methods.name: plan.deny
methods.summary: Reject a pending macro plan with a reason.

methods.name: memory.query
methods.summary: Query memories within the allowed scopes.

methods.name: memory.correct
methods.summary: Correct a memory from a client.

methods.name: memory.provenance
methods.summary: Inspect memory provenance.

methods.name: skills.search
methods.summary: Search skills by text and group.

methods.name: skills.load
methods.summary: Load a SKILL.md body and resolve deferred tools.

methods.name: skills.install
methods.summary: Install a skill from the store or a path.

methods.name: capability.register
methods.summary: Register an app or extension manifest.

methods.name: capability.invoke
methods.summary: Invoke a capability operation.

methods.name: capability.list
methods.summary: List registered capabilities.

methods.name: vault.create
methods.summary: Create a secret entry (separate secure call).

methods.name: vault.update
methods.summary: Update a secret entry value or policy.

methods.name: vault.list_metadata
methods.summary: List secret metadata, never values.

methods.name: vault.lock
methods.summary: Lock the vault.

methods.name: vault.unlock
methods.summary: Unlock the vault.

methods.name: vault.delete
methods.summary: Delete a secret entry after confirmation.

methods.name: question.answer
methods.summary: Answer a pending blocking or non-blocking question.

methods.name: metrics.query
methods.summary: Query token, cost and execution metrics.

methods.name: files.list
methods.summary: Lazy paginated file listing honoring .gitignore.

methods.name: config.get
methods.summary: Read configuration values.

methods.name: config.set
methods.summary: Write configuration values.

methods.name: config.list
methods.summary: List configuration keys.
